ticker_news.title: AI Data Center Spending By Nvidia, Microsoft And Other 'Mag 7' Titans Is Squeezing S&P 500 Share Buybacks, Goldman Sachs Warns
ticker_news.description: Goldman Sachs reports that Magnificent Seven tech companies are diverting significant funds to AI data center construction, which is slowing down their share buyback activities in 2025.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen

ticker_news.title: Resumption of Fed Easing Cycle Could Help Unlock Capital
ticker_news.description: The Federal Reserve is expected to begin an easing cycle with potential rate cuts, which could unlock significant capital from money market funds and provide additional support for the equity markets, particularly if rate reductions align with market expectations.
ticker_news.author: Jeff Buchbinder
